'''Matarbari Summit power station''' is a cancelled power station in Maheshkhali Upazila - Cox's Bazar District, Chittagong, Bangladesh.

==Background==

'''In July 2018''', Reuters reported that U.S. General Electric, Japan’s Mitsubishi Corporation, and Bangladesh-based Summit will build a 2,400 megawatt (MW) thermal power plant and related oil and LNG terminals.<ref name=reut>[https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-energy-investment/bangladesh-signs-deal-with-general-electric-mitsubishi-to-invest-3-billion-in-energy-idUSKBN1K11SI Bangladesh unveils $5.8 billion energy investment, two JV's with General Electric], ''Reuters'', Jul 11, 2018</ref> At the time, the $3 billion agreement was "the biggest ever private foreign direct investment (FDI) in the power sector in Bangladesh".<ref>[https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/power-energy/2018/07/11/summit-signs-3-billion-investment-deal-with-ge-and-mitsubishi Summit signs $3 billion investment deal with GE and Mitsubishi], ''Dhaka Tribune'', Jul 11, 2018</ref>

'''In July 2018,''' Reuters reported that approximately 30% of Bangladesh's population does not have access to electricity. The country relies on its gas resources for 70 percent of its energy production, but as demand has risen, its supply has struggled to keep up, and the country is now becoming an LNG importer.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-energy-investment/bangladesh-signs-deal-with-general-electric-mitsubishi-to-invest-3-billion-in-energy-idUSKBN1K11SI|title=Bangladesh unveils $5.8 billion energy investment, two JV's with General Electric|last=Serajul Quadir|work=U.S.|access-date=2022-08-17|language=en-US}}</ref>

The proposed plant is expected to come online in 2023.<ref name=":0">[https://www.asiaoutlookmag.com/outlook-features/summit-power-international Power to the People], ''Asia Outlook Magazine'', Oct 12, 2018</ref>

Summit will be the majority owner of the project, while Mitsubishi and GE will share the rest of the ownership.<ref name="Platts">[https://summitpowerinternational.com/bigger-projects-funds-singapore Bigger projects with funds from Singapore], Summit Power International website, Aug 8, 2018</ref>
